snippet.title: Wild Assault Season 2: Phantom Fracture Roundup
snippet.description:
#WildAssault Early Access Season 2: Phantom Fracture Roundup 
- New Valiant: Crock 
- New Map: Impel Sandbar 
- New Weapons
- Achievement System 🎉
- New Items Series: Tropical Mint, Dead Drop, Summer Surf, and More! 
- Complete Valiant/Weapon Balancing 
- New switchable BP System 
... And much more!
Full details: https://steamcommunity.com/games/2827230/announcements/detail/506206686159047385
————————————————————————————————————————
